entities.name: Adriana
entities.description: The captain of the guard of the High City of Paliano, who serves the ghost king Brago, then turns against Queen Marchesa and proposes a republic.

entities.name: King Brago
entities.description: The ghost king of Paliano, paranoid and crueler in death than in life, who is assassinated by Kaya.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: A poisonmaster and distant relative of the royal family who hires an assassin to kill Brago and is crowned queen of Paliano.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and ghost hunter in a strange jacket whose violet rondel dagger kills King Brago; she can turn translucent and pass through objects.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: A well-respected elven explorer whom Adriana asks to be senator of a new Republic of Paliano.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: Ghostly clergy who counsel Brago, crown Marchesa and accept her tithe.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The city ruled by Brago and then Marchesa, in turmoil as Adriana rallies its people.

entities.name: Thieves' Quarter
entities.description: A crowded district of Paliano where Adriana makes her speech against Marchesa.

entities.name: Academy
entities.description: An institution of invention and innovation in Paliano that Adriana was ordered to dismantle.

entities.name: Brago's sword
entities.description: The ghost king's sword, left behind when he dies; Adriana takes it and wields it as a symbol.

entities.name: Republic of Paliano
entities.description: The republic Adriana proposes to build with Selvala as a senator to halt the cycle of tyrants.

events.summary: Adriana stands guard as King Brago, now a paranoid ghost, meets with two Custodi ghosts in the great dining hall.
events.quote: King Brago sat at the head of his dining room table before a clean plate and sparkling silverware

events.summary: Adriana recalls being ordered to dismantle the Academy and purge invention from the city.
events.quote: To dismantle the Academy, to purge the pursuit of invention and innovation from the city.

events.summary: The Custodi bless Adriana with a formal goodbye before leaving.
events.quote: Adriana received the blessing willingly

events.summary: Adriana finds a servant girl throwing out the crown's plates because Her Ladyship dislikes them, hinting at a coming queen.
events.quote: Boss told us that Her Ladyship didn't like the plates,

events.summary: Adriana bursts into the dining hall to find Kaya driving a rondel dagger into King Brago's neck.
events.quote: a rondel dagger buried deep in the neck of her king

events.summary: Adriana swings her sword through Brago's face at the assassin, but Kaya turns translucent and it passes harmlessly.
events.quote: She drew her sword and swung it directly through the face of King Brago

events.summary: King Brago dies a second death as a violet necrosis dissolves his ghostly form, leaving his armor and crown.
events.quote: in a matter of seconds the king's form had vanished.

events.summary: Adriana attacks Kaya with Brago's sword, but Kaya turns phantom and grins at her shock.
events.quote: In an instant the assassin's stomach turned a bizarre and translucent violet

events.summary: Kaya says she was paid to hit only one mark and will not kill Adriana.
events.quote: I was paid to hit only one mark. I'm not going to kill you,

events.summary: Kaya tells Adriana that as long as tyrants die, freedom lives, and Adriana is struck by guilt.
events.quote: As long as tyrants die, the chance for freedom lives.

events.summary: Kaya sinks through the floor and escapes.
events.quote: The stranger straightened her jacket smartly and dropped into the floor.

events.summary: Adriana takes up Brago's sword, deciding it is safest in her hands.
events.quote: Adriana's fingers grazed the hilt of Brago's sword.

events.summary: The Custodi crown Marchesa as Queen of Paliano the next day.
events.quote: The Custodi crowned Queen Marchesa, the First of her Name, the following day.

events.summary: Adriana finds her guard shares her confusion and rage about the coup.
events.quote: Adriana was relieved to find all of them as deep in the dark as she was.

events.summary: Adriana realizes the coup took bribes to the Custodi, payment to the staff and to the assassin.
events.quote: Bribes to pay off the Custodi.

events.summary: Adriana confronts Marchesa about right of succession, and Marchesa says the Custodi accepted a legal will naming her heir.
events.quote: But the Custodi was very willing to accept properly filed legal documents.

events.summary: Marchesa reveals she dealt with Brago's descendants so that her name was next in succession.
events.quote: I dealt with them a while ago, however, and it just so happened that my name was next in the line of succession.

events.summary: Marchesa admits she paid Kaya to kill Brago.
events.quote: Well, Kaya killed Brago. Paid her good money for it, too.

events.summary: Marchesa offers Adriana a black-rose breastplate; Adriana refuses.
events.quote: You already know I'm not putting that on.

events.summary: Marchesa says that if the people call her a tyrant she will be tyrannical.
events.quote: Then I will be tyrannical

events.summary: Adriana spits in Marchesa's face and leaves with the breastplate.
events.quote: Adriana spat in the Queen's face.

events.summary: Adriana rides through the city dragging the rose breastplate behind her horse.
events.quote: tied the dreadful rose-adorned breastplate to a rope

events.summary: Marchesa publicly announces that the former captain has retired with a pension.
events.quote: The former captain has retired, with thanks from our fair city

events.summary: Adriana speaks to the crowd in the Thieves' Quarter, calling Marchesa's rule illegitimate and urging the people not to bow to her flag.
events.quote: Marchesa would have you stand with her, in service to a true crown resting upon a false head

events.summary: Members of Brago's guard secretly break their oaths to patrol the streets and protect citizens.
events.quote: Those who served in Brago's guard broke their oaths to the crown under cover of darkness

events.summary: Months later Adriana visits the elven explorer Selvala at her home.
events.quote: The elven explorer Selvala stood on the other side of the door

events.summary: Adriana proposes that Selvala serve as senator to halt Paliano's murderous monarchy.
events.quote: the finest nominee for a senator I can think of.

events.summary: Adriana asks Selvala to help build the Republic of Paliano.
events.quote: Will you help us build the Republic of Paliano?

relations.note: She is his captain of the guard until his death.
relations.quote: a post that puts her in the service of the ghost king, Brago

relations.note: She rejects Marchesa's usurpation and rallies the city against her.
relations.quote: Our city will not turn over to you so easily.

relations.note: Marchesa hired Kaya to assassinate Brago.
relations.quote: Paid her good money for it, too.

relations.note: Kaya stabbed the ghost king with a violet dagger.
She is crowned queen of the High City.
relations.quote: the velvet-drenched queen of the High City of Paliano

relations.note: She bribes the Custodi and promises them yearly tithes.
relations.quote: the Custodi will receive a healthy tithing during each year of my reign.

relations.note: Her family was small and distant in the royal family tree.
relations.quote: Marchesa's family was small and distant in the royal family tree.
